一、(60 分) 考虑下列质量为 m 的粒子在二维平面极坐标 $(r, \theta)$ 的拉格朗日量:

$$
L (r, \dot {r}; \theta , \dot {\theta}; t) = \frac {1}{2} m \dot {r} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} m r ^ {2} \dot {\theta} ^ {2} - \frac {m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}{2 (1 + \alpha t) ^ {2}} (\alpha , \omega > 0)
$$

设粒子的运动时间 $t \geq 0$ ，回答下列问题：

(1) 准对称变换是关于物理参数的无穷小变换, 对于任意的拉格朗日量, 令坐标通过无穷小参数 $\epsilon \rightarrow 0$ 变换为:

$$
r \rightarrow r + \epsilon G _ {r} \theta \rightarrow \theta + \epsilon G _ {\theta} t \rightarrow t + \epsilon G _ {t}
$$

用新参数重写原本的作用量，准对称变换满足前后的作用量在 $O(\epsilon)$ 水平下等价，即新旧作用量差量为某个函数 $\epsilon F(r,\theta,t)$ 在作用量时间边界 $t_{b} \sim t_{f}$ 的差值 $\epsilon F|_{t_{b}}^{t_{f}}$ 。

a. (2 分) 证明变换后的拉氏量为 $L' = L + \epsilon \frac{dF}{dt} - \epsilon L \frac{dG_t}{dt}$ ;

b. (10 分) 证明诺特定理, 即上述变换诱导了守恒量:

$$
C = G _ {t} H + F - G _ {r} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} - G _ {\theta} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}}
$$

其中 H 是系统的哈密顿量;

(2) (12 分) 题述拉格朗日系统存在 $G_{\theta} = 1, G_{r,t} = 0$ 的准对称变换，诱导了守恒量 $C = -h$ 。此外，系统还存在另一个准对称变换，它诱导了守恒量 $C = \mathcal{E}$ :

$$
r \rightarrow r + \epsilon G _ {r} (r, t, \alpha) \quad t \rightarrow t + \epsilon G _ {t} (t, \alpha) (G _ {t} (\alpha = 0) := 1)
$$

请找出 $G_{t}, G_{r}$ 函数，并根据诺特定理写出 E 关于 $(r, \theta, t)$ 以及 $\dot{r}, \dot{\theta}$ 的表达式；

(3) (8 分) 根据上述结果，设 $\omega < \alpha / 2$ ，求出 $h = 0, \mathcal{E} = 0$ 情形的 $r(t)$ 解。设 $r(t = 0) = r_0$ ;

(4) 在 $\omega = \alpha / 2$ 情形下 (结果不包含 $\alpha$ ):

a. (8 分) 求出 $h = 0, \mathcal{E} > 0$ 时的 $r(t)$ 函数，设 $r(t = 0) = r_0$ ;

b. (8 分) 对于 $\mathcal{E}, h > 0$ 时，证明存在合适的变量替换方式，使得：

$$
1 = (1 + \zeta x) ^ {2} \left(\frac {d y}{d x}\right) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{y ^ {2}}
$$

找出 $x, y, \zeta$ 和题给参数的关系，并考虑变换 $\tau := \ln (1 + \zeta x)$ ，在 $y(x = 0) = 1$ 的条件下给出 $r(t)$ 函数。

(5) 对于 $\alpha \rightarrow 0$ 情形，在哈密顿量体系下：

a. (6 分) 根据正则方程, 补全下列相流的转移矩阵:

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c} r (t + d t) \\ \theta (t + d t) \\ P _ {r} (t + d t) \\ P _ {\theta} (t + d t) \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c}? & ? & ? & ? \\ ? & ? & ? & ? \\ ? & ? & ? & ? \\ ? & ? & ? & ? \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} r (t) \\ \theta (t) \\ P _ {r} (t) \\ P _ {\theta} (t) \end{array} \right)
$$

并验证刘维尔定理：相空间体积元随着时间演进保持不变；

b. (6 分) 考虑相空间中 $h = 0, \mathcal{E} > 0$ 的子空间，在子空间轨道上证明微正则系综假设：粒子在相空间体积元上停留的概率密度 $\rho \propto \delta(\mathcal{E} - E)$ ，其中 $E$ 是粒子的能量。
questions.analysis:
根据题设，可知：

$$
\begin{array}{l} L ^ {\prime} d t ^ {\prime} = L d t + \epsilon \frac {d F}{d t} = L ^ {\prime} d (t + \epsilon G _ {t}) = L ^ {\prime} \left(1 + \epsilon \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}\right) d t \\ \implies \boxed {L ^ {\prime} = L + \epsilon \frac {d F}{d t} - \epsilon L \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}} \end{array}\tag{1.a.1:2分}
$$

【本题满分共2分】

如果系统前后作用量相差一个常数，那么拉格朗日量普遍地满足：

$$
\begin{array}{r} L ^ {\prime} - L = \epsilon \frac {d F}{d t} - \epsilon L \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} = \frac {\partial L}{\partial r} \epsilon G _ {r} + \frac {\partial L}{\partial \theta} \epsilon G _ {\theta} \\ + \frac {\partial L}{\partial t} \epsilon G _ {t} + \epsilon \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} \Delta \dot {r} + \epsilon \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} \Delta \dot {\theta} \end{array}\tag{1.b.1:2分}
$$

其中：

$$
\dot {r} ^ {\prime} = \frac {d (r + \epsilon G _ {r})}{d (t + \epsilon G _ {t})} \approx \left(\dot {r} + \epsilon \frac {d G _ {r}}{d t}\right) \left(1 - \epsilon \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}\right)
$$

$$
\Longrightarrow \boxed {\Delta \dot {r} = \epsilon \frac {d G _ {r}}{d t} - \epsilon \dot {r} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}} \quad \boxed {\Delta \dot {\theta} = \epsilon \frac {d G _ {\theta}}{d t} - \epsilon \dot {\theta} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}}\tag{1.b.2:2分}
$$

最终得到:

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\epsilon \frac {d F}{d t} - \epsilon L \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} = \epsilon \left(\frac {\partial L}{\partial r} G _ {r} + \frac {\partial L}{\partial \theta} G _ {\theta} + \frac {\partial L}{\partial t} G _ {t}\right)} \\ & {\qquad + \epsilon \left(\frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} \frac {d G _ {r}}{d t} + \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} \frac {d G _ {\theta}}{d t} - \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} \dot {r} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} - \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} \dot {\theta} \frac {d G _ {\theta}}{d t}\right)} \end{array}\tag{1.b.3:1分}
$$

应用欧拉—拉格朗日方程，得到：

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\epsilon \frac {d F}{d t} - \epsilon L \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} = \epsilon \left(G _ {r} \frac {d}{d t} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} + G _ {\theta} \frac {d}{d t} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} + \frac {\partial L}{\partial t} G _ {t}\right)} \\ & {\qquad + \epsilon \left(\frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} \frac {d G _ {r}}{d t} + \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} - \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} \dot {r} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} - \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} \dot {\theta} \frac {d G _ {\theta}}{d t}\right)} \\ & {\qquad = \epsilon \frac {d}{d t} \left(G _ {r} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} + G _ {\theta} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}}\right) + \epsilon \frac {\partial L}{\partial t} G _ {t} - \epsilon \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} \left(\dot {r} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} + \dot {\theta} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}}\right)} \end{array}\tag{1.b.4:2分}
$$

注意到哈密顿量和拉格朗日量之间的关系:

$$
\begin{array}{c} \frac {\partial L}{\partial t} = - \frac {d H}{d t} \Longrightarrow \epsilon \frac {d}{d t} \left(F - \dot {r} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} - \dot {\theta} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}}\right) = - \epsilon \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} H - \epsilon G _ {t} \frac {d H}{d t} \\ \Longrightarrow \boxed {\frac {d C}{d t} = \frac {d}{d t} \left[ G _ {t} H + F - G _ {r} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} - G _ {\theta} \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} \right] = 0} \end{array}\tag{1.b.5:3分}
$$

公式得证。

【本题满分共10分】

根据前一问的结果，可以写出新的拉格朗日量：

$$
\begin{array}{r} L ^ {\prime} = \frac {1}{2} m \left(\dot {r} + \epsilon \frac {d G _ {r}}{d t} - \epsilon \dot {r} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}\right) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} m (r + \epsilon G _ {r}) ^ {2} (\dot {\theta} - \epsilon \dot {\theta} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}) ^ {2} \\ - \frac {m \omega^ {2}}{2 (1 + \alpha t + \alpha \epsilon G _ {t}) ^ {2}} (r + \epsilon G _ {r}) ^ {2} \end{array}\tag{2.b.1:2分}
$$

展开至 $\epsilon$ 的领头项：

$$
\begin{array}{r} L ^ {\prime} - L + \epsilon \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} L \approx \epsilon m \dot {r} \left(\frac {\dot {r}}{2} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} + \frac {d G _ {r}}{d t} - \dot {r} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}\right) + \epsilon m \dot {\theta} ^ {2} \left(\frac {r ^ {2}}{2} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} + r \epsilon G _ {r} - r ^ {2} \epsilon \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}\right) \\ + \frac {\epsilon \alpha m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2} G _ {t}}{(1 + \alpha t) ^ {3}} - \frac {\epsilon m \omega^ {2} r G _ {r}}{(1 + \alpha t) ^ {2}} - \frac {\epsilon m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}{2 (1 + \alpha t) ^ {2}} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} \end{array}\tag{2.b.2:2分}
$$

为了确保这是准对称变换，无法被纳入全微分的 $\dot{\theta}$ 项必须为零：

$$
\epsilon m \dot {\theta} ^ {2} \left(r \epsilon G _ {r} - \frac {r ^ {2}}{2} \epsilon \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}\right) = 0 \Longrightarrow \boxed {G _ {r} = \frac {r}{2} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t}}\tag{2.b.3 : 2 分}
$$

代入原式得到:

$$
\begin{array}{r} L ^ {\prime} - L = \frac {1}{2} \epsilon m \dot {r} \left(\frac {d}{d t} (r \dot {G} _ {r}) - \dot {r} \dot {G} _ {r}\right) + \frac {\epsilon \alpha m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2} G _ {t}}{(1 + \alpha t) ^ {3}} - \frac {\epsilon m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}{(1 + \alpha t) ^ {2}} \frac {d G _ {t}}{d t} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \epsilon m r \dot {r} \ddot {G} _ {r} - \frac {\epsilon m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}{(1 + \alpha t) ^ {2}} (\dot {G} _ {t} - \frac {\alpha G _ {t}}{1 + \alpha t}) \end{array}\tag{2.b.4:2分}
$$

此处可以发现一个合法解:

$$
\boxed {G _ {t} = 1 + \alpha t G _ {r} = \frac {1}{2} \alpha r F = 0}\tag{2.b.5 : 3 分}
$$

诱导的守恒量为:

$$
\mathcal {E} = (1 + \alpha t) \left(\frac {1}{2} m \dot {r} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} m r ^ {2} \dot {\theta} ^ {2} + \frac {m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}{2 (1 + \alpha t) ^ {2}}\right) - \frac {1}{2} m \alpha r \dot {r}\tag{2.b.6 : 1 分}
$$

【本题满分共12分】

守恒量 h 为:

$$
\begin{array}{l} h = - 1 \times \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} = m r ^ {2} \dot {\theta} \\ \implies \mathcal {E} = \frac {1}{2} m (1 + \alpha t) \dot {r} ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2} m \alpha r \dot {r} + \frac {(1 + \alpha t) h ^ {2}}{2 m r ^ {2}} + \frac {m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}{2 (1 + \alpha t)} \end{array}\tag{3.b.1:2分}
$$

按照题设要求，可以写出：

$$
\begin{array}{c} 0 = \frac {1}{2} m (1 + \alpha t) \dot {r} ^ {2} - m \alpha r \dot {r} + \frac {m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}{2 (1 + \alpha t)} \\ = \frac {m [ (1 + \alpha t) \dot {r} - \alpha r / 2 ] ^ {2} + m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2} - m \alpha^ {2} r ^ {2} / 4}{2 (1 + \alpha t)} \end{array}\tag{3.b.2:3分}
$$

由此发现:

$$
\begin{array}{l} (1 + \alpha t) \dot {r} - \frac {1}{2} \alpha r = \pm \sqrt {\frac {\alpha^ {2}}{4} - \omega^ {2}} r \Longrightarrow \frac {d r}{r} = \frac {(\frac {\alpha}{2} \pm \sqrt {\frac {\alpha^ {2}}{4} - \omega^ {2}}) d t}{1 + \alpha t} \\ \boxed {r (t) = r _ {0} \sqrt {1 + \alpha t} ^ {1 \pm \sqrt {1 - (\frac {2 \omega}{\alpha}) ^ {2}}}} \end{array}\tag{3.b.3:3分}
$$

解集的选取有赖于初始条件

【本题满分共8分】

此时的方程为:

$$
\mathcal {E} = \frac {m [ (1 + 2 \omega t) \dot {r} - \omega r ] ^ {2}}{2 (1 + 2 \omega t)} \Longrightarrow (1 + 2 \omega t) \dot {r} - \omega r = \pm \sqrt {\frac {2 \mathcal {E}}{m} (1 + 2 \omega t)}\tag{4.a.1:2分}
$$

直接使用一阶非齐次线性微分方程的通解，得到：

$$
\begin{array}{l} \dot {r} - \frac {\omega}{1 + 2 \omega t} r = \pm \sqrt {\frac {2 \mathcal {E}}{m (1 + 2 \omega t)}} \\ \implies r = e ^ {\int \frac {\omega d t}{1 + 2 \omega d t}} \left(r _ {0} + \int_ {0} ^ {t} \pm \sqrt {\frac {2 \mathcal {E}}{m (1 + 2 \omega \tau)}} e ^ {- \int \frac {\omega d t}{1 + 2 \omega t}} d \tau\right) \end{array}\tag{4.a.2:2分}
$$

代入计算得到:

$$
\begin{array}{l} \Longrightarrow r = \sqrt {1 + 2 \omega t} \left(r _ {0} \pm \int_ {0} ^ {t} \frac {\sqrt {2 \mathcal {E} / m}}{(1 + 2 \omega \tau)} d \tau\right) \\ \Longrightarrow \boxed {r = \sqrt {1 + 2 \omega t} \left[ r _ {0} \pm \frac {1}{2 \omega} \sqrt {\frac {2 \mathcal {E}}{m}} \ln (1 + 2 \omega t) \right]} \end{array}\tag{4.a.3:4分}
$$

【本题满分共8分】

此时有：

$$
\mathcal {E} = \frac {m [ (1 + 2 \omega t) \dot {r} - \omega r ] ^ {2}}{2 (1 + 2 \omega t)} + \frac {h ^ {2} (1 + 2 \omega t)}{2 m r ^ {2}}\tag{4.b.1:0分}
$$

最好定义:

$$
r = R \sqrt {1 + 2 \omega t} \Longrightarrow (1 + 2 \omega t) \dot {r} - \omega r = (1 + 2 \omega t) ^ {3 / 2} \dot {R}\tag{4.b.2:1分}
$$

代入得到:

$$
1 = \frac {m (1 + 2 \omega t) ^ {2} \dot {R} ^ {2}}{2 \mathcal {E}} + \frac {h ^ {2}}{2 m \mathcal {E} R ^ {2}}\tag{4.b.3:1分}
$$

它已经是问题要求的形式，直接考虑无量纲化就可以了。对等式右侧无量纲化，此时两项乘积和 R 无关，可以给出 t 的无量纲化，它对应 x:

$$
\frac {1}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {m}{2 \mathcal {E} t ^ {2}} \times \frac {h ^ {2}}{2 m \mathcal {E}} = \frac {h ^ {2}}{4 \mathcal {E} ^ {2} t ^ {2}} \Longrightarrow x = \frac {2 \mathcal {E}}{h} t\tag{4.b.4:1分}
$$

现在更进一步地，完成 $R$ 的无量纲化，显然：

$$
\frac {1}{y ^ {2}} = \frac {h ^ {2}}{2 m \mathcal {E} R ^ {2}} \Longrightarrow y = \frac {\sqrt {2 m \mathcal {E}}}{h} R\tag{4.b.5 : 1 分}
$$

最后 $\zeta$ 应当是:

$$
\zeta x = 2 \omega t = \frac {h \omega}{\mathcal {E}} x \quad \zeta = \frac {h \omega}{\mathcal {E}}\tag{4.b.6 : 1 分}
$$

为了求解这个方程，通过定义 $\tau = \ln(1 + \zeta x)$ ，那么：

$$
1 - \frac {1}{y ^ {2}} = \zeta^ {2} \left(\frac {d y}{d \tau}\right) ^ {2} \Longrightarrow d \tau = \frac {\zeta y d y}{\pm \sqrt {y ^ {2} - 1}}\tag{4.b.7:0分}
$$

直接积分给出:

$$
\tau = \mp \zeta \sqrt {y ^ {2} - 1}\tag{4.b.8:1分}
$$

从题给结果来看，时间积分必须存在，因此只能选择正根分支，得到：

$$
y = \sqrt {1 + \frac {\tau^ {2}}{\zeta^ {2}}} \Longrightarrow r = \frac {h \sqrt {1 + 2 \omega t}}{\sqrt {2 m \mathcal {E}}} \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {\mathcal {E} \ln (1 + 2 \omega t)}{\hbar \omega}\right) ^ {2}}\tag{4.b.9 : 2 分}
$$

【本题满分共8分】

系统的哈密顿量为:

$$
P _ {r} = \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {r}} = m \dot {r} P _ {\theta} = \frac {\partial L}{\partial \dot {\theta}} = m r ^ {2} \dot {\theta} H = P _ {r} \dot {r} + P _ {\theta} \dot {\theta} - L = \frac {P _ {r} ^ {2}}{2 m} + \frac {P _ {\theta} ^ {2}}{2 m r ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}\tag{5.a.1:2分}
$$

正则方程可以直接写出，给出相流矩阵：

$$
\dot {r} = \frac {\partial H}{\partial P _ {r}} = \frac {P _ {r}}{m} \dot {\theta} = \frac {\partial H}{\partial P _ {\theta}} = \frac {P _ {\theta}}{m r ^ {2}} \dot {P} _ {r} = - \frac {\partial H}{\partial r} = - m \omega^ {2} r + \frac {P _ {\theta} ^ {2}}{m r ^ {3}} \dot {P} _ {\theta} = - \frac {\partial H}{\partial \theta} = 0
$$

$$
\Longrightarrow \left( \begin{array}{c} r (t + d t) \\ \theta (t + d t) \\ P _ {r} (t + d t) \\ P _ {\theta} (t + d t) \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 1 & 0 & \frac {d t}{m} & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac {d t}{m r ^ {2}} \\ - m \omega^ {2} d t & 0 & 1 & \frac {P _ {\theta} d t}{m r ^ {3}} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} r (t) \\ \theta (t) \\ P _ {r} (t) \\ P _ {\theta} (t) \end{array} \right)\tag{5.a.2 : 2 分}
$$

采用被动观点，将上述相流看作一个相空间的坐标变换，刘维尔定理的成立性就是上述相流矩阵的行列式为1，或者说在 $O(dt)$ 精度下如此：

$$
\det \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 1 & 0 & \frac {d t}{m} & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac {d t}{m r ^ {2}} \\ - m \omega^ {2} d t & 0 & 1 & \frac {P _ {\theta} d t}{m r ^ {3}} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) = 1 \times (1 + 0 + 0) + \frac {d t}{m} [ - 1 \times (- m \omega^ {2} d t) + 0 ]\tag{5.a.3 : 2 分}
$$

$$
= 1 + (\omega d t) ^ {2} \approx 1
$$

因此刘维尔定理成立。

【本题满分共6分】

停留在相空间的概率应当用停留时间刻画：

$$
d P \propto d t = \int \delta (\mathcal {E} - E) d t d E\tag{5.b.1:2分}
$$

其中 E 被视作系统的守恒量 E 可变时的取值，此时有：

$$
\begin{array}{r l} h = P _ {\theta} = 0 & E = \frac {P _ {r} ^ {2}}{2 m} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2} = \frac {1}{2} m \dot {r} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} r ^ {2} \\ & \Longrightarrow \dot {r} = \sqrt {\frac {2 E}{m} - \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}, d t = \frac {d r}{\dot {r}} = \frac {d r}{\sqrt {\frac {2 E}{m} - \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}}} \end{array}\tag{5.b.2 : 2 分}
$$

考虑相空间密度:

$$
\begin{array}{r} \rho \propto \frac {d t}{d r d P _ {r}} = \delta (\mathcal {E} - E) \frac {d t d E}{d r d P _ {r}} = \delta (\mathcal {E} - E) \frac {d E}{\sqrt {\frac {2 E}{m} - \omega^ {2} r ^ {2}} d P _ {r}} \\ = \delta (\mathcal {E} - E) \frac {P _ {r} d P _ {r} / m}{m P _ {r} d P _ {r}} \propto \delta (\mathcal {E} - E) \end{array}\tag{5.b.3:2分}
$$

微正则系综假设得证。

【本题满分共6分】
questions.answer:
(1) a. $L' = L + \epsilon\dfrac{dF}{dt} - \epsilon L\dfrac{dG_t}{dt}$。

(1) b. 守恒量为

$$
C = G_t H + F - G_r\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{r}} - G_\theta\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}}, \qquad \frac{dC}{dt} = 0
$$

(2) $G_t = 1 + \alpha t$，$G_r = \dfrac{1}{2}\alpha r$，$F = 0$，诱导的守恒量为

$$
\mathcal{E} = (1+\alpha t)\left(\frac{1}{2}m\dot{r}^2 + \frac{1}{2}mr^2\dot{\theta}^2 + \frac{m\omega^2 r^2}{2(1+\alpha t)^2}\right) - \frac{1}{2}m\alpha r\dot{r}
$$

（其中 $h = mr^2\dot{\theta}$。）

(3) $\omega < \alpha/2$、$h = 0$、$\mathcal{E} = 0$ 时

$$
r(t) = r_0\sqrt{1+\alpha t}^{\,1 \pm \sqrt{1-\left(\frac{2\omega}{\alpha}\right)^2}}
$$

(4) a. $\omega = \alpha/2$、$h = 0$、$\mathcal{E} > 0$ 时

$$
r = \sqrt{1+2\omega t}\left[r_0 \pm \frac{1}{2\omega}\sqrt{\frac{2\mathcal{E}}{m}}\ln(1+2\omega t)\right]
$$

(4) b. 取 $x = \dfrac{2\mathcal{E}}{h}t$，$y = \dfrac{\sqrt{2m\mathcal{E}}}{h}R$（其中 $r = R\sqrt{1+2\omega t}$），$\zeta = \dfrac{h\omega}{\mathcal{E}}$，$\tau = \ln(1+\zeta x)$；满足 $y(x=0)=1$ 时

$$
r = \frac{h\sqrt{1+2\omega t}}{\sqrt{2m\mathcal{E}}}\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{\mathcal{E}\ln(1+2\omega t)}{h\omega}\right)^2}
$$

(5) a. 相流转移矩阵为

$$
\begin{pmatrix} r(t+dt) \\ \theta(t+dt) \\ P_r(t+dt) \\ P_\theta(t+dt) \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & \dfrac{dt}{m} & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \dfrac{dt}{mr^2} \\ -m\omega^2 dt & 0 & 1 & \dfrac{P_\theta dt}{mr^3} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} r(t) \\ \theta(t) \\ P_r(t) \\ P_\theta(t) \end{pmatrix}
$$

该矩阵行列式 $= 1 + (\omega dt)^2 \approx 1$，故刘维尔定理成立（相空间体积元随时间不变）。

(5) b. $h = 0$ 时 $E = \dfrac{P_r^2}{2m} + \dfrac{1}{2}m\omega^2r^2$，$dt = \dfrac{dr}{\sqrt{2E/m - \omega^2r^2}}$，于是

$$
\rho \propto \frac{dt}{dr\,dP_r} \propto \delta(\mathcal{E} - E)
$$

微正则系综假设得证。

二、(40 分) 取库仑规范 $\nabla \cdot \vec{A} = 0$ ，此规范下的各向同性旋光电磁场可用下列作用量描写：

$$
S [ \vec {A} ] = \int d t d ^ {3} x \left. \frac {1}{2 \mu_ {0}} \left[ \frac {n ^ {2}}{c ^ {2}} \frac {\partial \vec {A}}{\partial t} \cdot \left(\frac {\partial \vec {A}}{\partial t} + \chi \nabla \times \frac {\partial \vec {A}}{\partial t}\right) - (\nabla \times \vec {A}) ^ {2} \right] \right.
$$

其中 $\mu_0, c, n$ 为真空磁导率、光速和折射率， $\chi$ 为各向同性旋光物质的磁光长度。

(1) (16 分) 根据最小作用量原理, 确定 $\vec{A}$ 的运动方程;

(2) (12 分) 设电磁波满足平面波解 $\vec{A} = \vec{A}_k e^{i\vec{k}\cdot \vec{r} - i\omega t}$ , 试确定旋光介质色散关系 $\omega (\vec{k})$ 和对应模式的归一化本征偏振矢量 $\hat{Q}$ (取 $\vec{k} = k\hat{z}$ );

(3) (10 分) 令介质中角频率为 $\omega$ 的电磁波沿着 $\hat{z}$ 方向在 $z < 0$ 区域传播。 $z = -\frac{c\phi}{n\omega} (\phi > 0)$ 处的电磁波是 $\hat{x}$ 方向的线偏振光。

设 $z \geq 0$ 区域是电导率无穷大的理想金属介质，求金属反射上述电磁波后， $z < 0$ 空间中 $z = -\frac{c\phi}{n\omega}$ 处的电磁波偏振特性。

(4) (2 分) 直接回答在上述介质中的加速电荷激发的不同模式偏振光电磁辐射功率是否相等。
questions.analysis:
(1) 默认爱因斯坦求和规定，可以看出上述作用量是关于 $A_{i}, \partial_{i} A_{j}, \dot{A}_{i}$ 以及 $\partial_{i} \dot{A}_{j}$ 的泛函，最小作用量原理应当写作：

$$
\begin{array}{l} \delta S = \int d t d ^ {3} x \left[ \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial A _ {i}} \delta A _ {i} + \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial \dot {A} _ {i}} \delta \dot {A} _ {i} + \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} A _ {j})} \delta (\partial_ {i} A _ {j}) + \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} \dot {A} _ {j})} \delta (\partial_ {i} \dot {A} _ {j}) \right] \\
= \int d t d ^ {3} x \left[ \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial A _ {i}} \delta A _ {i} + \frac {\partial}{\partial t} \left(\frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial \dot {A} _ {i}} \delta A _ {i}\right) - \frac {\partial}{\partial t} \left(\frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial \dot {A} _ {i}}\right) \delta A _ {i} \right. \\
- \partial_ {i} \left(\frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} A _ {j})}\right) \delta A _ {j} + \partial_ {i} \left(\frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} A _ {j})} \delta A _ {j}\right) \\
+ \frac {\partial}{\partial t} \left(\partial_ {i} \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} \dot {A} _ {j})}\right) \delta A _ {j} - \frac {\partial}{\partial t} \left(\partial_ {i} \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} \dot {A} _ {j})} \delta A _ {j}\right) - \partial_ {i} \left(\frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} \dot {A} _ {j})} \delta \dot {A} _ {j}\right) \Bigg ] \end{array}\tag{1..1:4分}
$$

其中所有全导数项都可以通过分部积分去除，余下了：

$$
\begin{array}{l} \delta S = \int d t d ^ {3} x \left[ \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial A _ {i}} - \frac {\partial}{\partial t} \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial \dot {A} _ {i}} - \partial_ {j} \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial \partial_ {j} A _ {i}} + \partial_ {j} \left(\partial_ {t} \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {j} \dot {A} _ {i})}\right) \right] \delta A _ {i} = 0 \\
\implies \boxed {\frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial A _ {i}} - \frac {\partial}{\partial t} \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial \dot {A} _ {i}} - \partial_ {j} \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial \partial_ {j} A _ {i}} + \partial_ {j} \left(\partial_ {t} \frac {\partial \mathcal {\mathscr {L}}}{\partial (\partial_ {j} \dot {A} _ {i})}\right) = 0} \end{array}\tag{1..2 : 2 分}
$$

现在代入旋光的拉氏量，利用：

$$
\begin{array}{r} \nabla \times \vec {A} = \varepsilon_ {i j k} \partial_ {i} A _ {j} \varepsilon_ {n m k} \partial_ {n} A _ {m} = (\delta_ {i n} \delta_ {j m} - \delta_ {i m} \delta_ {j n}) \partial_ {i} A _ {j} \partial_ {n} A _ {m} \\
= \partial_ {i} A _ {j} \partial_ {i} A _ {j} - \partial_ {i} A _ {j} \partial_ {j} A _ {i} \end{array}\tag{1..3 : 2 分}
$$

因此可以用指标形式将拉氏量密度写作:

$$
\mathcal {L} = \frac {1}{2 \mu_ {0}} \left[ \frac {n ^ {2}}{c ^ {2}} \dot {A} _ {i} \dot {A} _ {i} + \frac {n ^ {2} \chi}{c ^ {2}} \varepsilon_ {i j k} \dot {A} _ {k} \partial_ {i} \dot {A} _ {j} - \partial_ {i} A _ {j} \partial_ {i} A _ {j} + \partial_ {i} A _ {j} \partial_ {j} A _ {i} \right]\tag{1..4:2分}
$$

计算得到:

$$
\frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial A _ {i}} = 0 \quad \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial \dot {A} _ {i}} = \frac {n ^ {2}}{\mu_ {0} c ^ {2}} \dot {A} _ {i} + \frac {n ^ {2} \chi}{2 \mu_ {0} c ^ {2}} \varepsilon_ {n m i} \partial_ {n} \dot {A} _ {m}
$$

$$
\frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} A _ {j})} = - \frac {1}{\mu_ {0}} (\partial_ {i} A _ {j} - \partial_ {j} A _ {i}) \quad \frac {\partial \mathcal {L}}{\partial (\partial_ {i} \dot {A} _ {j})} = \frac {n ^ {2} \chi}{2 \mu_ {0} c ^ {2}} \varepsilon_ {i j k} \dot {A} _ {k}\tag{1..5 : 2 分}
$$

代入演化方程得到:

$$
\frac {\partial}{\partial t} \left(\frac {n ^ {2}}{\mu_ {0} c ^ {2}} \dot {A} _ {i} + \frac {n ^ {2} \chi}{2 \mu_ {0} c ^ {2}} \varepsilon_ {n m i} \partial_ {n} \dot {A} _ {m}\right) + \partial_ {j} \left(\frac {\partial_ {i} A _ {j} - \partial_ {j} A _ {i}}{\mu_ {0}}\right) - \frac {n ^ {2} \chi}{2 \mu_ {0} c ^ {2}} \varepsilon_ {j i k} \partial_ {j} \ddot {A} _ {k} = 0
$$

$$
\frac {n ^ {2}}{c ^ {2}} \ddot {A} _ {i} - \nabla^ {2} A _ {i} + \frac {n ^ {2} \chi}{c ^ {2}} \varepsilon_ {j k i} \partial_ {j} \ddot {A} _ {k} = 0 \Longrightarrow \boxed {\frac {n ^ {2}}{c ^ {2}} \frac {\partial^ {2} \vec {A}}{\partial t ^ {2}} - \nabla^ {2} \vec {A} + \frac {n ^ {2} \chi}{c ^ {2}} \nabla \times \frac {\partial^ {2} \vec {A}}{\partial t ^ {2}} = 0}\tag{1..6 : 4 分}
$$

(2) 设定平面波解，得到：

$$
- \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} \vec {A} _ {k} + | \vec {k} | ^ {2} \vec {A} _ {k} - i \chi \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} \vec {k} \times \vec {A} _ {k} = 0\tag{2..1 : 2 分}
$$

不妨设定 $\hat{k}$ 为 z 方向，相对它引进与之正交的 x, y 方向。此时可以写出：

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\left[ \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} - | \vec {k} | ^ {2} \right] A _ {k, x} - i \chi \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} | \vec {k} | A _ {k, y} = 0} \\
& {\left[ \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} - | \vec {k} | ^ {2} \right] A _ {k, y} + i \chi \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} | \vec {k} | A _ {k, x} = 0} \end{array}\tag{2..2 : 2 分}
$$

考虑第一条方程叠加第二条方程的 $\pm i$ 倍，给出：

$$
\left[ \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} - | \vec {k} | ^ {2} \right] (A _ {k, x} \pm i A _ {k, y}) \mp \chi \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} | \vec {k} | (A _ {k, y} \pm i A _ {k, y}) = 0\tag{2..3 : 2 分}
$$

可以看出来 $A_{k,x} \pm iA_{k,y}$ 是上述方程的本征矢量，因此可以使用本征矢量完成分解：

$$
\vec {A} _ {k} := A _ {+} \hat {Q} _ {+} + A _ {-} \hat {Q} _ {-} \quad \hat {Q} _ {\pm} = \frac {\hat {x} \pm i \hat {y}}{\sqrt {2}}\tag{2..4 : 2 分}
$$

此时可以发现:

$$
\begin{array}{r l} A _ {k, x} \pm i A _ {k, y} & = \frac {A _ {+} + A _ {-} \pm i (i A _ {+} - i A _ {-})}{\sqrt {2}} \\
& = \frac {A _ {+} + A _ {-} \pm (A _ {-} - A _ {+})}{\sqrt {2}} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} + & \sqrt {2} A _ {-} \\
- & \sqrt {2} A _ {+} \end{array} \right. \end{array}\tag{2..5 : 2 分}
$$

所以 $A_{k,x} + iA_{k,y}$ 对应 $A_{-}$ 模式，因此用 $A_{\pm}$ 重新分类频率解，此时：

$$
\left(\frac {n \omega_ {\pm}}{c}\right) ^ {2} - | \vec {k} | ^ {2} \pm \chi \left(\frac {n \omega_ {\pm}}{c}\right) ^ {2} | \vec {k} | = 0 \Longrightarrow \omega_ {\pm} = \frac {c | \vec {k} |}{n \sqrt {1 \pm \chi | \vec {k} |}}\tag{2..6 : 2 分}
$$

(3) 反解波矢得到:

$$
k _ {\pm} := | \vec {k} _ {\pm} | = \pm \frac {\chi}{2} \left(\frac {n \omega}{c}\right) ^ {2} + \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {\chi n \omega}{2 c}\right) ^ {2}} \frac {n \omega}{c}\tag{3..1:2分}
$$

此时得到入射区域中的初始波通解:

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\vec {A} _ {I} = (A _ {+} e ^ {i k _ {+} z} \hat {Q} _ {+} + A _ {-} e ^ {i k _ {-} z} \hat {Q} _ {-}) e ^ {- i \omega t}} \\
& {\quad \Longrightarrow A _ {+} e ^ {- i c k _ {+} \phi / (n \omega)} \hat {Q} _ {+} + A _ {-} e ^ {- i c k _ {-} \phi / (n \omega)} \hat {Q} _ {-} \propto \hat {x}} \end{array}\tag{3..2 : 2 分}
$$

上述关系给出方程:

$$
A _ {+} e ^ {- i c k _ {+} \phi / (n \omega)} - A _ {-} e ^ {- i c k _ {-} \phi / (n \omega)} = 0 \quad \frac {A _ {+}}{A _ {-}} = \exp \left(\frac {i c \phi (k _ {+} - k _ {-})}{n \omega}\right) = \exp \left(\frac {i \chi n \omega \phi}{c}\right)\tag{3..3 : 2 分}
$$

由于电场为 $\vec{E} = -\partial \vec{A} / \partial t$ ，这导致了反射波必须在 $z = 0$ 满足总矢势 $\sum \vec{A} = 0$ 。此处需要反射波的本征矢量，此时 $k_{+}$ 对应的本征矢量会翻转为 $\hat{Q}_{-}$ ，由此写出：

$$
\vec {A} _ {R} = - \left(A _ {+} e ^ {- i k _ {-} z} \hat {Q} _ {+} + A _ {-} e ^ {- i k _ {+} z} \hat {Q} _ {-}\right) e ^ {- i \omega t}\tag{3..4 : 2 分}
$$

此时给出了原本线偏振方位的总矢势：

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\vec {A} _ {\mathrm{Total}} = \left(A _ {+} (e ^ {- i c k _ {+} \phi / (n \omega)} - e ^ {i c k _ {-} \phi / (n \omega)}) \hat {Q} _ {+} + A _ {-} (e ^ {- i c k _ {-} \phi / (n \omega)} - e ^ {i c k _ {+} \phi / (n \omega)}) \hat {Q} _ {-}\right) e ^ {- i \omega t}} \\
& {\qquad = A _ {-} (e ^ {- i c k _ {-} \phi / (n \omega)} - e ^ {i c k _ {+} \phi / (n \omega)}) e ^ {- i \omega t} \left(\frac {e ^ {- i c k _ {+} \phi / (n \omega)} - e ^ {i c k _ {-} \phi / (n \omega)}}{e ^ {- i c k _ {-} \phi / (n \omega)} - e ^ {i c k _ {+} \phi / (n \omega)}} e ^ {\frac {i x n \omega \phi}{c}} \hat {Q} _ {+} + \hat {Q} _ {-}\right)} \\
& {\qquad = A _ {-} (e ^ {- i c k _ {-} \phi / (n \omega)} - e ^ {i c k _ {+} \phi / (n \omega)}) e ^ {- i \omega t} (\hat {Q} _ {+} + \hat {Q} _ {-}) \propto \hat {x}} \end{array}\tag{3..5 : 2 分}
$$

由此发现最终结果仍然是 x 方向线偏振光。

(4) 不相等

考虑弱旋光 $\chi \omega / c \ll 1$ 情形，每个辐射成分的格林函数会具有形式 $G(r) \propto \int \frac{e^{ikr} k^2 dk\hat{k} \cdot \hat{Q} d\Omega}{\omega^2 - \omega_k^2}$ ，这一过程的 $\omega_k$ 满足 $\omega_k \sim k(1 \pm \chi...)$ ，这个结果不破坏标准的亥姆霍兹方程格林函数 $\frac{e^{ikr}}{r} = \frac{e^{i\omega r / c_{\mathrm{eff}}}}{r}$ 。这个结果导致了弱旋光条件下，两种模式的激发仍然是推迟势，但是有效的光速对于不同模式是不同的。由于辐射功率和光速、频率以及电荷振荡速度有关，所以不同的等效光速导致了不同的辐射功率。

三、(60 分) 本问题由两个独立的部分组成，已知玻尔兹曼常数为 $k_{B}$ 。若有需要，可以定义参数 $\beta = 1 / (k_{B}T)$ ， $T$ 是可能需要的环境温度：

(1) 设某一维无相互作用量子气体的单粒子能量动量关系为 $\varepsilon (\vec{p}) = v|\vec{p}|$ 。设气体在热力学温度为 $T$ 的条件下平衡。在两种情况下计算气体的一维定体热容密度 $c_{V} := C_{V} / L$ ，忽略粒子自旋的贡献。

a. (7 分) 粒子是场激发的玻色子;

b. (7 分) 粒子是费米子，且费米能级为 $\varepsilon_{F} := vp_{F} \gg k_{B} T$ ;

(2) 考虑周期性边界条件的铁磁一维 Ising 模型，它由 $N(N \gg 1)$ 个可分辨的 $\frac{1}{2}$ 自旋组成，设其无量纲 $z$ 方向角动量分量为 $s(s = \pm 1)$ ，一维 Ising 模型满足周期性边界条件 $s_{N+1} = s_1$ ，并受到微弱的不均匀外场激发，哈密顿量为：

$$
H = - J \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {N} s _ {i} s _ {i + 1} - \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {N} h _ {i} s _ {i} \quad J > 0, | h _ {i} | \ll J
$$

设体系处于热力学温度为 T 的热平衡态，回答下列问题：

a. (6 分) 计算无外场条件 $h = 0$ 下的短程二体自旋关联函数 $S_{1} := \langle s_{i}s_{i+1} \rangle$ , 并写出零温极限 $T \to 0$ 下的表达式, 反铁磁情形 $J < 0$ 呢? 【提示: 定义 $\chi_{i} = s_{i}s_{i+1}$ 】

b. (4 分) 续 (2)a., 求出长程二体自旋关联函数 $S_{n} := \langle s_{i}s_{i+n} \rangle$ ;

c. (2 分) 引进一维 Ising 问题的转移矩阵 T，其 $ss'(s = \pm1)$ 分量 $T_{ss'}$ 被规定满足：

$$
Z = \sum_ {s _ {1}, s _ {2}, s _ {3} \ldots = \pm 1} T _ {s _ {1} s _ {2}} T _ {s _ {2} s _ {3}} T _ {s _ {3} s _ {4}} \ldots T _ {s _ {N} s _ {1}} = \mathrm{Tr} (T ^ {N})
$$

写出转移矩阵，规定 11 为矩阵左上侧分量；

d. (10 分) 设转移矩阵的对角化矩阵为 $\Lambda := \begin{pmatrix} \lambda_{+} & 0 \\ 0 & \lambda_{-} \end{pmatrix}$ 其中 $\lambda_{\pm}$ 是转移矩阵较大/较小的本征值。证明四体自旋关联函数 $\langle s_1 s_3 s_7 s_8 \rangle$ 可以写作下列形式：

$$
\langle s _ {1} s _ {3} s _ {7} s _ {8} \rangle = \frac {1}{Z} \mathrm{Tr} (K \Lambda^ {2} K \Lambda^ {4} K \Lambda K \Lambda^ {N - 7}) \quad K = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right)

\Rightarrow K - \frac {\beta (1 - \tanh \beta J \cos q)}{1 + \tanh ^ {2} \beta J - 2 \tanh \beta J \cos q} <   0 \end{array}\tag{2.g.4:2分}
$$

这个结果无法通过 $q \to 0$ 过渡到无外场情形，因为 $\cos (2qn + r)$ 的求和在 $q \neq 0$ 情形下精确消失，但是 q = 0 为 1。

定义 $x = \beta J \gg 1$ ，低温条件下的近似形式为：

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & K = \frac {\beta [ 1 - (1 - \frac {2 e ^ {- x}}{e ^ {x} + e ^ {- x}}) (1 - \frac {q ^ {2}}{2}) ]}{1 + (1 - \frac {2 e ^ {- x}}{e ^ {x} + e ^ {- x}}) ^ {2} - 2 (1 - \frac {2 e ^ {- x}}{e ^ {x} + e ^ {- x}}) (1 - \frac {q ^ {2}}{2})} \\
& \approx \beta \frac {1 - (1 - 2 e ^ {- 2 x} - q ^ {2} / 2)}{2 - 4 e ^ {- 2 x} - 2 (1 - 2 e ^ {- 2 x} - q ^ {2} / 2)} \\
& = \beta \frac {2 e ^ {- 2 x} - q ^ {2} / 2}{q ^ {2}} \Longrightarrow K k _ {B} T = \frac {2}{q ^ {2}} \exp \left(- \frac {2 J}{k _ {B} T}\right) - \frac {1}{2} \end{array}\tag{2.g.5:2分}
$$

最终得到了低温可激发的模式:

$$
K k _ {B} T \leq \frac {2}{q ^ {2}} \exp \left(- \frac {2 J}{k _ {B} T}\right) - \frac {1}{2} \Longrightarrow q \leq \frac {2 e ^ {- J / (k _ {B} T)}}{\sqrt {2 K k _ {B} T + 1}} \sim e ^ {- J / (k _ {B} T)} / \sqrt {T}\tag{2.g.6 : 2 分}
$$

【备注】在最低阶微扰中，弱配对定理就已经足够了。但是对于一切高阶微扰，完整的配对定理是必要的，因为 $\left\langle s_{i}s_{j}s_{k}s_{l}\right\rangle=\left\langle s_{i}s_{j}\right\rangle\left\langle s_{k}s_{l}\right\rangle$ ，中央的空隙会对 $h_{q}$ 的三角函数求和产生影响，它应当通过引进互补部分 $\left\langle s_{j}s_{k}\right\rangle$ 来修补。

四、(40 分) 设一维掺杂介质可看作长度为 $L(L \to +\infty)(L$ 远大于载流子物质波波长) 的一维环,此时载流子动量本征态是离散态,且态数求和为 $\sum_{p} = \frac{L}{2\pi\hbar}\int dp$ , 其中 $\hbar$ 是约化普朗克常数。介质中导带底部的载流子运动可近似用单粒子哈密顿量描述:

$$
\hat {H} = \frac {\hat {p} ^ {2}}{2 m} + U _ {R} (\hat {x}, t)
$$

其中 $\hat{x}$ 是载流子在环上的位置算符， $\hat{p}$ 是载流子在环上的动量算符，m 是载流子在导带底的有效质量。 $U_{R}(\hat{x}, t)$ 是无规巡游杂质对载流子产生的作用势，可视作微扰。无规杂质势的统计平均满足：

$$
\langle U _ {R} (x, t) \rangle = 0 \quad \langle U _ {R} (x, t) U _ {R} (x ^ {\prime}, t ^ {\prime}) \rangle = \Gamma \exp \left(- \frac {| t - t ^ {\prime} |}{\tau}\right) \exp (- \mu | x - x ^ {\prime} |)
$$

其中 $\Gamma, \tau, \mu > 0$ 是已知常数。

(1) (4 分) 设动量本征态为 $|p\rangle$ ，在相互作用绘景中证明：

$$
\langle p | \hat {A} _ {I} (t) | p ^ {\prime} \rangle = e ^ {- i (E _ {p ^ {\prime}} - E _ {p}) t / \hbar} \langle p | \hat {A} _ {S} | p ^ {\prime} \rangle
$$

其中 $\hat{A}_{I,S}$ 分别是相互作用绘景和薛定谔绘景的算符， $E_{p}=p^{2}/(2m)$ 是粒子能量；

(2) (12 分) 设 t = 0 时刻的粒子态是 $\left|\Psi_{0}\right\rangle = \left|p = \hbar k\right\rangle$ ，考虑产生非零平均贡献的最低阶含时微扰论，用 $U_{R}(x, t)$ 和最简形式的定积分表示 $\langle p' | \Psi_{I}(t) \rangle$ ;

(3) (18 分) 假设时间 $t \gg \tau$ ，证明平均散射水平下的粒子整体不会跃迁到其他动量态，但是电子处于当前动量态的概率会缩小，求出该速率 $v$ ；

(4) (6 分) 求动量为 p 的载流子的运动全衰期 $\tau_{p}$ (存活概率衰减到原本的 $\frac{1}{2.718\ldots}$ 所需时间);
questions.analysis:
(1) 相互作用绘景的定义就是用零级算符 $\hat{H}_{0}=\frac{\dot{p}^{2}}{2m}$ 构造的海森堡绘景，因此：

$$
\hat {A} _ {I} (t) = e ^ {i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar} \hat {A} e ^ {- i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar} \Longrightarrow \langle p | \hat {A} _ {I} (t) | p ^ {\prime} \rangle = \langle p | e ^ {i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar} \hat {A} e ^ {- i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar} | p ^ {\prime} \rangle
$$

根据对偶规则:

$$
\begin{array}{r l} e ^ {- i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar} | p ^ {\prime} \rangle = e ^ {- i E _ {p ^ {\prime}} t / \hbar} | p ^ {\prime} \rangle & \langle p | e ^ {i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar} = (e ^ {- i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar} | p \rangle) ^ {\dagger} = \langle p | e ^ {i E _ {p} t / \hbar} \\ & \Longrightarrow \langle p | \hat {A} _ {I} (t) | p ^ {\prime} \rangle = e ^ {- i (E _ {p ^ {\prime}} - E _ {p}) t / \hbar} \langle p | \hat {A} | p ^ {\prime} \rangle \end{array}
$$

(2) 在相互作用绘景中，时间演化通过下列含时薛定谔方程给出：

$$
i \hbar \frac {\partial}{\partial t} | \Psi_ {I} \rangle = \hat {H} _ {0, I} (t) | \Psi_ {I} \rangle \quad \hat {H} _ {0, I} = e ^ {i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar} \hat {U} _ {R} e ^ {- i \hat {H} _ {0} t / \hbar}
$$

将 $\hat{H}_{0,I}$ 看作含时微扰，此时可以用零级 $\left|\Psi_{I}\right\rangle=\left|p\right\rangle$ 替代算符后的态矢量：

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {| \Psi_ {I} ^ {(1)} \rangle = | p \rangle - \frac {i}{\hbar} \int_ {0} ^ {t} \hat {H} _ {0, I} (\tau) d \tau | p \rangle} \\ & {| \Psi_ {I} ^ {(2)} \rangle = | p \rangle - \frac {i}{\hbar} \int_ {0} ^ {t} \hat {H} _ {0, I} (\tau) d \tau | \Psi_ {I} ^ {(1)} \rangle} \\ & {\quad = | p \rangle - \frac {1}{\hbar^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {t} \hat {H} _ {0, I} (\tau_ {1}) d \tau_ {1} \int_ {0} ^ {\tau_ {1}} \hat {H} _ {0, I} (\tau_ {2}) d \tau_ {2} | p \rangle} \end{array}
$$

在一阶水平下， $\langle \hat{H}_{0,I} \rangle = 0$ 导致了一阶结果不可能贡献非零修正。必须要考虑二阶修正，这里给出精确到二阶的公式：

$$
\begin{array}{r} \langle p ^ {\prime} | \Psi_ {I} (t) \rangle = \langle p ^ {\prime} | \Psi_ {I} ^ {(2)} \rangle = \langle p ^ {\prime} | p \rangle - \frac {i}{\hbar} \int_ {0} ^ {t} \langle p ^ {\prime} | \hat {H} _ {0, I} (\tau) | p \rangle d \tau \\ - \frac {1}{\hbar^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {t} d \tau_ {1} \int_ {0} ^ {\tau_ {1}} d \tau_ {2} \langle p ^ {\prime} | \hat {H} _ {0, I} (\tau_ {1}) \hat {H} _ {0, I} (\tau_ {2}) | p \rangle \end{array}
$$

现在往二阶部分插入完备性条件 $\sum_{q}|q\rangle \langle q| = \frac{L}{2\pi\hbar}\int dq|q\rangle \langle q| = \hat{I}$ ，并利用上一问的矩阵元结果彻底标量化公式：

$$
\langle p ^ {\prime} | \hat {U} _ {R} | p \rangle = \int d x \frac {e ^ {- i p ^ {\prime} x / \hbar}}{\sqrt {L}} U _ {R} (x, t) \frac {e ^ {i p x / \hbar}}{\sqrt {L}} = \frac {1}{L} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} d x e ^ {i (p - p ^ {\prime}) x / \hbar} U _ {R} (x, t)
$$

所以：

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\langle p ^ {\prime} | \Psi_ {I} (t) \rangle = \delta_ {p p ^ {\prime}} - \frac {i}{\hbar} e ^ {- i (p ^ {2} - p ^ {\prime 2}) t / (2 m \hbar)} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \frac {d x}{L} e ^ {i (p - p ^ {\prime}) x / \hbar} U _ {R} (x, t)} \\ & {\qquad - \frac {1}{2 \pi \hbar^ {3} L} \int_ {0} ^ {t} d \tau_ {1} \int_ {0} ^ {\tau_ {1}} d \tau_ {2} e ^ {- i [ (q ^ {2} - p ^ {\prime 2}) \tau_ {1} + (p ^ {2} - q ^ {2}) \tau_ {2} ] / (2 m \hbar)}} \\ & {\qquad \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} d q \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} e ^ {i [ (q - p ^ {\prime}) x _ {1} + (p - q) x _ {2} ] / \hbar} d x _ {1} d x _ {2} U _ {R} (x _ {1}, \tau_ {1}) U _ {R} (x _ {2}, \tau_ {2})} \end{array}
$$

(3) 根据相互作用绘景，完成平均计算，可以得到：

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\langle p ^ {\prime} | \Psi_ {I} (t) \rangle = \delta_ {p p ^ {\prime}} - \frac {\Gamma}{2 \pi \hbar^ {3} L} \int_ {0} ^ {t} d \tau_ {1} \int_ {0} ^ {\tau_ {1}} d \tau_ {2} e ^ {- | \tau_ {1} - \tau_ {2} | / \tau} e ^ {- i [ (q ^ {2} - p ^ {\prime 2}) \tau_ {1} + (p ^ {2} - q ^ {2}) \tau_ {2} ] / (2 m \hbar)}} \\ & {\qquad \int e ^ {- \mu | x _ {1} - x _ {2} |} d x _ {1} d x _ {2} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} d q e ^ {i [ - p ^ {\prime} (x _ {1} - x _ {2}) + q (x _ {1} - x _ {2}) + (p - p ^ {\prime}) x _ {2} ] / \hbar}} \end{array}
$$

现在考虑将 $dx_{1}dx_{2}$ 换成 $d(x_{1}-x_{2})dx_{2}$ 积分，并利用下列公式完成 $x_{2}$ 积分：

$$
\begin{array}{r} \int e ^ {i q x _ {2} / \hbar} d x _ {2} = L \delta_ {q, 0} \Longrightarrow \langle p ^ {\prime} | \Psi_ {I} (t) \rangle = \delta_ {p p ^ {\prime}} - \frac {\Gamma \delta_ {p p ^ {\prime}}}{2 \pi \hbar^ {3}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} d q \int_ {0} ^ {t} d \tau_ {1} \int_ {0} ^ {\tau_ {1}} d \tau_ {2} \\ e ^ {- (\tau_ {1} - \tau_ {2}) / \tau} e ^ {- i [ (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) (\tau_ {1} - \tau_ {2}) ] / (2 m \hbar)} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} d x e ^ {- \mu | x |} e ^ {i (q - p) x / \hbar} \end{array}
$$

可以看出来，最终的散射态经过平均后仍然停留在原本的动量态，而且可以发现停留概率 $|\langle p|\Psi_I\rangle|^2$ 会随时间减小，这是我们将被散射到其他态的粒子通过矢量平均消去后的结果。为了求出速率，先略去 $q$ 积分，给出解析表达式。时间积分为：

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {\tau_ {1}} \exp \left(- \frac {1 + i \tau (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) / (2 m \hbar)}{\tau} x\right) = \frac {\tau \left[ 1 - e ^ {- [ 1 + i \tau (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) / (2 m \hbar) ] t _ {1} / \tau} \right]}{1 + i \tau (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) / (2 m \hbar)}
$$

如果说时间 t 远大于 $\tau$ ，这意味着公式中的指数部分积分几乎无贡献，只有常数 1 有贡献：

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {t} d \tau_ {1} \frac {\tau \left[ 1 - e ^ {- [ 1 + i \tau (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) / (2 m \hbar) ] t _ {1} / \tau} \right]}{1 + i \tau (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) / (2 m \hbar)} \approx \frac {\tau t}{1 + i \tau (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) / (2 m \hbar)}
$$

顺带完成空间积分:

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} d x e ^ {- \mu | x | + i (q - p) x / \hbar} & = \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} d x e ^ {- [ \mu - i (q - p) / \hbar ] x} + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {0} d x e ^ {[ \mu + i (q - p) / \hbar ] x} \\ & = \frac {1}{\mu - i (q - p) / \hbar} + \frac {1}{\mu + i (q - p) / \hbar} = \frac {2 \mu}{\mu^ {2} + (q - p) ^ {2} / \hbar^ {2}} \end{array}
$$

最终我们得到了结果:

$$
\langle p ^ {\prime} | \Psi_ {I} \rangle = \delta_ {p p ^ {\prime}} \left[ 1 - \frac {\Gamma t}{2 \pi \hbar^ {3}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} d q \frac {2 \mu \tau}{[ 1 + i \tau (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) / (2 m \hbar) ] [ \mu^ {2} + (q - p) ^ {2} / \hbar^ {2} ]} \right]
$$

相互作用绘景保证 $\langle p|\Psi_{I}\rangle$ 和 $\langle p|\Psi(t)\rangle$ 只会相差一个相位因子，停留在原本状态的概率为：

$$
P = | \langle p | \Psi (t) \rangle | ^ {2} \approx 1 - \frac {2 \mu \tau \Gamma t}{\pi \hbar^ {3}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \frac {d q}{[ 1 + \tau^ {2} (q ^ {2} - p ^ {2}) ^ {2} / (2 m \hbar) ^ {2} ] [ \mu^ {2} + (q - p) ^ {2} / \hbar^ {2} ]}
$$

所以初始粒子概率为 1 时的散射速率为:

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & v = \frac {1 - P}{t} = \frac {2 \mu \tau \Gamma}{\pi \hbar^ {3}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \frac {d q}{[ 1 + \tau^ {2} (q - p) ^ {2} (q - p + 2 p) ^ {2} / (2 m \hbar) ^ {2} ] [ \mu^ {2} + (q - p) ^ {2} / \hbar^ {2} ]} \\ & \quad = \frac {2 \mu \tau \Gamma}{\pi \hbar^ {3}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \frac {d l}{[ 1 + \frac {\tau^ {2} l ^ {2} (l + 2 p) ^ {2}}{(2 m \hbar) ^ {2}} ] [ \mu^ {2} + \frac {l ^ {2}}{\hbar^ {2}} ]} \xrightarrow {l = \hbar \mu z} \frac {2 \tau \Gamma}{\pi \hbar^ {2}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \frac {d z}{(1 + z ^ {2}) [ 1 + (\frac {\hbar \tau \mu^ {2}}{2 m}) ^ {2} z ^ {2} (z + \frac {2 p}{\hbar \mu}) ^ {2} ]}. \end{array}
$$

代入试题提供的公式表，选定 $\alpha=\frac{\hbar\tau\mu^{2}}{2m},\beta=\frac{2p}{\hbar\mu}$ ，得到：

$$
v = \frac {2 \tau \Gamma}{\pi \hbar^ {2}} \times \frac {2 \pi [ 1 + (\frac {\hbar \tau \mu^ {2}}{2 m}) ^ {2} (1 - (\frac {2 p}{\hbar \mu}) ^ {2}) ]}{[ 1 + (\frac {\hbar \tau \mu^ {2}}{2 m}) ^ {2} (1 - (\frac {2 p}{\hbar \mu}) ^ {2}) ] ^ {2} + [ \frac {4 p}{\hbar \mu} (\frac {\hbar \tau \mu^ {2}}{2 m}) ^ {2} ] ^ {2}}
$$

(4) 假设某一时刻的粒子停留在 p 态的概率为 P，那么调整时间零点，将态矢量设定为：

$$
| \Psi_ {I} (0) \rangle = \sqrt {P} e ^ {i \delta} | p \rangle
$$

此后重新求解问题，结果必须无异，只是跃迁的速率变为：

$$
v ^ {\prime} = v P \Longrightarrow \frac {d P}{d t} = - v P \Longrightarrow P (t) = e ^ {- v t}
$$

最终写出全衰期:

$$
\tau_ {p} = \frac {1}{v (p)} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4 \Gamma \tau} \left\{1 + \left(\frac {\hbar \tau \mu^ {2}}{2 m}\right) ^ {2} \left[ 1 - \left(\frac {2 p}{\hbar \mu}\right) ^ {2} \right] + \left(\frac {4 p}{\hbar \mu}\right) ^ {2} \frac {\left(\frac {\hbar \tau \mu^ {2}}{2 m}\right) ^ {2}}{1 + \left(\frac {\hbar \tau \mu^ {2}}{2 m}\right) ^ {2} \left[ 1 - \left(\frac {2 p}{\hbar \mu}\right) ^ {2} \right]} \right\}
$$

可以看出哪怕是动量为零的粒子，也仍然会因为随机散射而脱离原本的状态，这一观点也可以用于描述粒子被真空涨落场散射的过程。
